# Better Dating Photos - AI Dating Photo Generator

> Better Dating Photos turns one selfie into natural, app-ready dating profile photos for Tinder, Hinge, Bumble, and other dating apps.

Last updated: 2026-06-30

## Product
Better Dating Photos is an AI dating photo generator. Users upload one clear source photo, choose dating-friendly photo styles, and generate natural profile pictures for Tinder, Hinge, Bumble, and other dating or social profiles.

The product is optimized for believable likeness preservation: recognizable facial structure, natural skin texture, clear eyes, relaxed profile-ready lighting, and outputs that should not feel like fake AI makeovers.

## Core Product Facts
- One clear photo is enough to start
- New accounts can start with starter credits
- Standard 1K generations and Best 2K generations currently use the same trial credit pricing
- Best 2K generations produce more detail but can take about twice as long as Standard 1K
- Credit packs are one-time purchases, not subscriptions
- Paid credit packs start at $5.99 for 30 credits, enough for 10 default photos
- Uploads and generated photos are private account assets
- Users can remove source photos and generated outputs from normal product views
- Generated photos can be used for dating profiles, social profiles, and lawful personal profile use
- Better Dating Photos does not guarantee matches, messages, dates, app ranking changes, or app acceptance
- World Cup Stadium Fan is a World Cup-inspired dating photo style with country-inspired jersey colors, generic jersey number and badge details, stadium atmosphere, and Argentina as the default country option
- NSFW, sexualized, abusive, deceptive, impersonation, minor-related, or non-consensual image generation is prohibited
- Admin and account pages are private, not public product documentation, and should not be indexed
